# Global System Prompts

## Code Style Guidelines
```prompt
When modifying or creating code:
- Follow existing project code style
- Use consistent naming conventions
- Include appropriate comments
- Maintain type safety in TypeScript
- Consider responsive design in UI components
```

## UI/UX Guidelines
```prompt
When working on user interface:
- Use Roboto font family consistently
- Maintain responsive design principles
- Follow accessibility guidelines
- Use consistent color scheme
- Implement smooth transitions and animations
```

## State Management Guidelines
```prompt
When handling application state:
- Use React hooks appropriately
- Maintain immutable state updates
- Consider component lifecycle
- Implement proper error handling
- Clean up side effects
```

## API Integration Guidelines
```prompt
When working with APIs:
- Handle loading states
- Implement proper error handling
- Use appropriate error messages
- Consider rate limiting
- Implement proper authentication
```
